background:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: same-canvas EMPTY ROOM BACKGROUND extraction, not new concept art.
Input Image 1 is the ONLY edit target and ONLY reference: the approved Anon planning/apricot mother. Output exactly one 1536x1024 opaque RGB PNG, matching the input full canvas, camera, framing and all fixed coordinates.
Remove ONLY the pink-haired seated schoolgirl COMPLETELY, including every strand of hair, face, body, blazer, skirt, legs, both knee socks, BOTH complete brown shoes, both hands and the UPRIGHT WHITE PLANNING SHEET she holds. Remove only her independent cast/contact shadows from floor and furniture as needed for an empty room.
Reconstruct only the tiny room surfaces hidden by those removed things: the lake/window view behind her head, the original chair and seat, table surface and drawer, legs of chair and table, floor boards and their existing warm sun pattern. The chair remains exactly in place, intact, empty. The desk, lamp, cup and saucer, and all separate sheets already lying flat on the desk are room objects and MUST remain at their original positions. Do not remove or redraw these flat desk objects.
LOCK EVERYTHING else: window mullions, curtains, outdoor city/lake/sky, chair silhouette, furniture geometry, pillow, blanket, rug, tabletop props, floorboards, full palette, shadows not caused by the girl. Preserve original layout and background as tightly as possible. Do not move any furniture. No crop, zoom, resize, reframing, text, labels, grids, watermarks, second image, or new person. This output is only the clean empty room.
luminanceMask:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: same-canvas black and white LUMINANCE MASK ONLY.
Input Image 1 is the ONLY reference and edit target: the approved Anon planning/apricot mother. Output exactly one full-canvas 1536x1024 opaque PNG containing NO RGB drawing and NO color: only a white silhouette on pure black.
At the EXACT original pixel positions, pure white covers the ENTIRE visible pink-haired girl: all loose hair strands and long hair, face, neck, ears, every visible hand and finger, complete grey blazer and sleeves, green plaid skirt, both thighs/knees, BOTH full dark knee socks and BOTH COMPLETE brown shoes including toe, heels and soles. INCLUDE the complete UPRIGHT WHITE PLANNING SHEET held in her hands as part of the white silhouette. Preserve all small gaps between limbs, hair, and the sheet as black when background is visible.
Pure BLACK everywhere else: window, curtains, lake, floor, rug, chair back and chair seat and legs, desk and lamp, mug and saucer, all separate papers already lying flat on the table, other furniture, all floor/furniture cast shadows and independent contact shadows. Exclude furniture even where touching the figure. Soft anti-aliased greys allowed ONLY at the exact figure boundary for a thin edge. Do not include shadow blobs. Do not draw a new girl; do not change pose, silhouette, framing, scale, position, or anatomy. Do not output transparent checkerboard, split view, labels, arrows or a color cutout. It is a luminance mask, white foreground and black everything else.
